name: fathom
title: Fathom
description: Your portfolio in Raycast. Net worth, holdings, activities and idle cash from every brokerage connected to SnapTrade. Read-only.
author: shayan_abedi

commands.name: sign-in
commands.title: Sign in with SnapTrade
commands.subtitle: Fathom
commands.description: Sign in to SnapTrade with OAuth (read-only) or sign out.

commands.name: show-portfolio
commands.title: Show Portfolio
commands.subtitle: Fathom
commands.description: Net worth and accounts grouped by institution, with holdings per account.

commands.name: show-positions
commands.title: Show Positions
commands.subtitle: Fathom
commands.description: Every position across all accounts in one searchable list.

commands.name: show-fog
commands.title: Show Fog
commands.subtitle: Fathom
commands.description: How much cash is sitting idle and for how long.

commands.name: show-activities
commands.title: Show Activities
commands.subtitle: Fathom
commands.description: Trades, dividends and deposits across all accounts.

commands.name: connect-brokerage
commands.title: Connect Brokerage
commands.subtitle: Fathom
commands.description: Open the SnapTrade Connection Portal to link a brokerage (read-only) and review existing connections.

commands.name: search-position
commands.title: Search Position
commands.subtitle: Fathom
commands.description: Look up a ticker across all your accounts.

commands.name: menu-bar-portfolio
commands.title: Menu Bar Portfolio
commands.subtitle: Fathom
commands.description: Net worth in the menu bar, with per-account totals and idle cash.

preferences.name: authWorkerUrl
preferences.title: Auth Worker URL
preferences.description: URL of the deployed Fathom auth worker that exchanges and refreshes SnapTrade OAuth tokens. The client secret lives there, never in Raycast.

preferences.name: oauthClientId
preferences.title: SnapTrade OAuth Client ID
preferences.description: Public client_id of the SnapTrade OAuth app registered by the maintainer. Not a secret.

preferences.name: useFixtures
preferences.title: Data Source
preferences.label: Use bundled fixture data (demo mode)
preferences.description: Render sample Wealthsimple, Questrade and IBKR accounts instead of calling SnapTrade. Useful for screenshots and development.

preferences.name: enableDevPersonalKey
preferences.title: Developer
preferences.label: Use a SnapTrade Personal API key instead of OAuth (developers only)
preferences.description: Bypass OAuth with your own SnapTrade Personal API key. For extension development only, not for Store users.

preferences.name: devPersonalApiKey
preferences.title: Personal API Key (dev)
preferences.description: Only used when the developer checkbox above is enabled. Stored by Raycast, never written to disk by Fathom.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
